units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:4:8">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵇ</cite> top <he>לכל ג׳ וג׳ וכ׳</he> to each creature its needs.

<cite ref="Yoma 80b:7">Yoma 80ᵇ</cite> <he>טומאת ג׳</he> some ed. (oth. sing.) the uncleanness of the inner body.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 25a:6">Kidd. 25ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>גְּוִיּוֹת</he>. Midr. Sam. ch. XX <he>גויית</he> some ed. (corr. acc.).
